description.short: A bright, blissful flashback to the turn of the new millennium.
description.standard: An abundance of electric mid-tempo rhythm and emotive ballads recall fond memories of fresh musical beginnings. Indonesian pop unfolds through melodic narratives, whether it's Sheila On 7's inspired slices of alt-rock guitar lines and lyrical strings, or Ecoutez's sun-kissed jazzy serenades. Agnes Monica adds alluring R&B tones to the mix, underscoring romance with a sizzling, soft-swaying beat.

description.short: A survey of the decade’s definitive Indonesian pop cuts.
description.standard: One of the most notable shifts in Indonesian pop throughout the 2010s was the increasingly prominent use of the English language. Stephanie Poetri’s “I Love You 3000” and NIKI’s “lowkey” showed that next-gen Indonesian artists are more than adept at conversing with global listeners linguistically as well as stylistically. Tulus and Hindia are shining examples of how the biggest sensations can emerge from the grassroots scene. Groups such as RAN and HIVI! churned out catchy numbers underpinned with jazzy chords and funky rhythms.

description.short: Vulnerable hearts, powerhouse vocals and melodies that move deeply.
description.standard: Few idioms in Indonesian music come as emotionally charged as galau. It’s a word that encompasses a world of feelings and moods—heartache, longing, betrayal, reflection or self-searching. Unbound by genre but anchored by honest, relatable, lyric-driven melodies in nuanced shades of blue, galau ballads fill those late nights of loneliness and doubt with solace and warmth. Featuring some of Indonesian pop, rock and alternative music’s greatest voices, these galau essentials have struck a chord through the years with narratives and emotions that are intimately personal, yet universally understood.

description.short: The Indonesian star shows off unique vocals and stirring ballads.
description.standard: Raisa Andriana, known mononymously as Raisa, has been making waves on the Indonesian pop scene since her 2011 self-titled debut. Embodying a soulful, jazzy style, the singer/songwriter is known for velvety vocals that move smoothly between English and Indonesian in tracks that poetically explore the nature of life and love. Later songs show off her ability to integrate her music with varying instruments, like the 2018 single “My Kind of Crazy” with DJ Dipha Barus—a track with chilled-out, slow-paced beats, brightened with Barus’s synths and enriched with Raisa’s lush, refined voice.

description.short: The Indonesian vocalist can soundtrack any romantic moment.
description.standard: Originally know as the lead singer of Dewa 19, Ari Lasso launched a solo career in dark times. Facing drug addiction and dismissal from the band that he helped create, Lasso harnessed those experiences into a heartfelt, slow-burning catalogue of albums. His penchant for the dramatic is always evident in his music, with every track building into a tsunami of big-scale vocals and soaring guitar solos.
